title: Item:Silver Goblet
wikitext:
[[Image:Silver Goblet.png|right]]
This item can be found in the Level 11 quest [[The Spawn of Whisperdoom]]. Once outside the quest, the [[Ungurz Lieutenant]] will exchange the''' Silver Goblet''' for your choice from a short list of randomly genarated items - the [[Item:Widow_Weave_Cloak|Widow Weave Cloak]] has a rare chance to be in that list.
